symptom: I ported an old WiringPi script to gpiozero and kept pin 6 (the physical pin 12 the LED is on). The LED never lights.

files.blink.py:
from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
# physical pin 12 was WiringPi 6 in the old script
led = LED(6)
while True:
    led.on()
    sleep(0.5)
    led.off()
    sleep(0.5)

gold.diagnosis: WiringPi and gpiozero use different numbering schemes. Physical pin 12 is BCM GPIO18, which WiringPi calls 6. gpiozero uses BCM, so the LED must be LED(18), not the WiringPi number 6.
